FOR SHOPPERS

Check a pack in three steps

  1. 01

    Find the pack code

    Scan the QR label where your browser supports it, or enter the printed code.

  2. 02

    Read the result

    Compare the product, lot and expiry against the pack. A matching code can be copied, so check the packaging too.

  3. 03

    Report a concern

    Sign in to tell Verifi what you noticed and where you found the product. Keep the reference to follow your report.

FOR COMPANIES

Put your product records behind every pack.

Apply with your company details and the first product you want to onboard. Verifi reviews applications before granting access to issue pack codes.

FOR INVESTIGATORS

A record to act on

Verifi operators can review shopper reports and refer cases to an assigned regulator workspace. Pack checks use manufacturer records. Official NAFDAC and SON registry checks are currently outside the platform.
